projects.name: Suraksha Bandhan
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Disaster Early Warning PWA
projects.description: Built an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) delivering real-time flood risk predictions and emergency alerts across 6 Indian languages with zero external backend dependencies. Integrated browser Geolocation API with Leaflet spatial mapping and OpenStreetMap Overpass API to calculate real-time river flood severity (High/Med/Low) based on precipitation and elevation data. Shortlisted in national hackathon competition; implemented emergency SOS dispatch triggering pre-configured emergency services with zero latency.
highlights: Offline-first PWA with multi-lingual emergency alerts in 6 Indian languages
Spatial river flood risk modeling using Leaflet and OpenStreetMap Overpass API
Zero-latency emergency SOS dispatch system for rapid community rescue
National Hackathon Shortlist recognition

projects.name: Exam Seating Auto-Allocator
projects.subtitle: Genetic Optimization & Constraint Solving
projects.description: Automated university examination hall allocation formulated as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) enforcing room capacity, branch mixing, and disability accommodation rules. Implemented genetic optimization algorithm with tailored crossover/mutation operators, cutting manual examination scheduling from 6 hours to under 15 minutes. Built a Flask administration portal generating official seat matrix PDFs; adopted by KIT examination cell in production across 2 consecutive semesters.
highlights: Cuts examination scheduling time from 6 hours to under 15 minutes
Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) for capacity and anti-cheating branch mixing
Production deployment adopted by KIT Examination Cell across 2 semesters
Flask administration dashboard generating official seat matrix PDFs

projects.name: FunLangLab & HindiCode
projects.subtitle: Vernacular Transpiler & Web IDE
projects.description: Developed a recursive descent parser and AST-based compiler supporting native Hindi and hybrid syntax, transpiling educational programming constructs directly into executable JavaScript. Engineered an in-browser execution sandbox with Claude API integration for automated syntax hint generation and natural-language error translation. Conducted user testing with 15 students at Barabanki secondary school; 80% of novice students wrote independent loops within 30 minutes.
highlights: Recursive descent parser & AST compiler transpiling Hindi constructs to JavaScript
In-browser sandbox with Claude API natural-language error translations
Tested with 15 secondary school students: 80% novice loop proficiency in 30 mins
Democratizing programming literacy for non-English speakers

projects.name: Smart IoT Water Telemetry
projects.subtitle: Ultrasonic Tank Monitoring System
projects.description: Architected an automated water level telemetry system using HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensors calibrated to cylindrical geometry, transmitting metrics via ESP8266 Wi-Fi over MQTT. Deployed production units across 2 campus hostel overhead tanks; prevented 3 overflow incidents in month one and cut water wastage by ~20%.
highlights: Calibrated ultrasonic sensors to non-linear cylindrical tank volumes
Real-time Wi-Fi telemetry over MQTT to mobile Blynk IoT dashboard
Production units deployed across 2 campus hostel overhead tanks
Prevented 3 overflow incidents and reduced campus water wastage by ~20%

projects.name: Pradite (Co-Founder)
projects.subtitle: Zero-Knowledge BYOK AI Platform
projects.description: Co-founded zero-knowledge Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI platform protecting developer code via client-side encryption using libsodium; drove initial developer onboarding and feedback loops. Built product distribution pipeline and community channels across student and indie developer clusters; synthesized bug reports to prioritize technical roadmap sprints.
highlights: Co-founded zero-knowledge BYOK AI platform protecting proprietary developer code
Client-side encryption with libsodium ensures zero server-side exposure
Built developer distribution channels and continuous feedback sprint loops

projects.name: India Space Academy GIS
projects.subtitle: Remote Sensing & Satellite Simulation
projects.description: Engineered client-side simulation engines for Vegetation Condition Index (VCI) drought severity mapping, Urban Heat Island analysis, and watershed prioritization using Digital Elevation Models (DEM). Translated satellite imagery processing algorithms into lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript modules packaged as single HTML files for offline use in low-bandwidth environments.
highlights: Simulation engines for VCI drought mapping & Urban Heat Island analysis
Watershed prioritization calculated using Digital Elevation Models (DEM)
Packaged satellite algorithms into dependency-free offline JavaScript modules

projects.name: Decentralized Land Registry
projects.subtitle: Ethereum Smart Contract Platform
projects.description: A decentralized land ownership title registry eliminating double-spending and fraudulent deed transfers through Ethereum smart contracts and immutable cryptographic proofs on-chain with React and Web3.js integration.
highlights: Immutable on-chain land title registry preventing fraudulent deed transfers
Smart contracts enforcing transparent multi-party ownership validation
Web3.js wallet authentication and verified decentralized state
